versions.name: Onteora
versions.address: 3 Old Hunter Road Livingston Manor, New York 12758

features.note: The waterfront area on Orchard Lake, with open boating, open swimming, a mile swim and boating competitions.
An astronomy outpost and star party run as an evening program.
A full-day hands-on rider course on the camp's own machines before riding the trails.
A bike track at the field sports area.
A climbing wall shared with the challenge course area, including a lit night climb.
A COPE and climbing area with a timed ranger course.
Moviemaking, animation and photography at the communications and technology area.
Shifted breakfast and dinner with a rolling midday meal, plus one in-site pizza night and a closing barbecue.
The Dan Beard program, split into a first tier covering Scout through Second Class and a Pathfinders tier continuing into First Class.
Includes an evening session at the fishing dock.
A craft lodge covering sculpture, leatherwork, basketry, pottery, textiles and wood carving.
A staffed first-aid station beside the trading post is the primary point of care in camp.
A frontier-era program area with branding, period skills and a Brownsea Island exhibit.
Run as an all-day trip off the reservation.
An older-Scout area teaching trades and repair skills.
Pavilions at seven campsites and at the archery instructional area.
Theater instruction that culminates in a Scout-written mock trial performance.
A range and target activities area offering an illuminated night shoot.
A technology hub covering robotics, programming, cybersecurity, game design, nuclear science and an escape room.
Includes early-morning polar bear swims and a water carnival.
On Orchard Lake, with new docks for the swimming section.
